summary: Infosys Limited filed a Form 6-K to report that the SEC issued an exemptive order (Release No. 34-105517) under Section 16(a)(5) of the Exchange Act, designating India as a qualifying jurisdiction and the SEBI PIT Regulations as a qualifying regulation. As a result, Infosys directors and officers are exempt from filing Forms 3, 4, and 5 with the SEC, while still complying with their insider-trading disclosure obligations under Indian law. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no shareholder vote, and no business combination involved.
